request: Rank the 4 best Ford Mustang generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
title: RANKING THE BEST FORD MUSTANG GENERATIONS
close_narration: So, which one captures your imagination—the Fox Body's charm, the Shelby's innovation, or the original Fastback's iconic design?
order_rationale: Ranked by weighted enthusiast desirability, driving engagement, historical significance, performance, collectibility, and value—not chronology.

entries.name: Third Generation Mustang 5.0 LX
entries.label: Fox Body Revival
entries.one_line_fact: Let’s rank every Ford Mustang generation. At number four, we've got the third-generation Mustang 5.0 LX, a symbol of the Fox Body's revival. Introduced in 1979, it offered affordable performance with its iconic boxy design and quad headlights, becoming a tuner favorite. Today, these cars are valued around $24K, a testament to their enduring impact.
entries.ranking_case: The Fox Body Mustang 5.0 LX is renowned for its modifiability and affordability, making it a staple in the performance community.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $24K.

entries.name: Fifth Generation Mustang GT
entries.label: Retro Revival
entries.one_line_fact: Then, came the fifth-generation Mustang GT, launching in 2005. Ford embraced retro styling with a modern twist, evident in its tri-bar taillights and prominent grille. It reignited muscle car passion at a time when the world needed it most.
entries.ranking_case: The fifth-generation Mustang GT successfully blended classic aesthetics with contemporary performance, appealing to both new and longtime fans.

entries.name: Sixth Generation Mustang Shelby GT350
entries.label: Track-Ready Beast
entries.one_line_fact: Evolution hit hard with the sixth-generation Mustang Shelby GT350 in 2015. It took Mustang to new heights with aggressive aerodynamics and a high-revving V8. But while the engineering was top-notch, some say the genuine muscle car spirit was refined away.
entries.ranking_case: The Shelby GT350 is lauded for its exceptional performance and driving dynamics, solidifying its place as a modern classic.

entries.name: First Generation Mustang GT Fastback
entries.label: The Original Icon
entries.one_line_fact: Finally, the first-generation Mustang GT Fastback clinches the top spot. Debuting in 1965, this original icon set the standard for American muscle with its fastback roofline and chrome bumpers. It's not just a car; it’s an era-defining masterpiece that captured enthusiasts' hearts.
entries.ranking_case: The original Mustang GT Fastback is celebrated for its groundbreaking design and performance, making it a timeless classic among enthusiasts.
